about.title: Who I Am
about.bio: I was a preschool teacher, then worked as a CRM specialist at a startup. Along the way, I realized I was always thinking like a developer — solving problems, optimizing processes, understanding people. So I decided to build things. I completed a full stack development bootcamp and now I'm here.
